adjudication.rationale: In Rails, routes declared directly inside a `resources :groups do ... end` block (without `collection do`) are member routes by default, using the parent resource’s key. The prior route `get "users"` in the same position would have generated `/admin/groups/:group_id/users`, and the new `delete "members"` / `put "members"` similarly generate `/admin/groups/:group_id/members(.:format)`, which matches the client calls to `/admin/groups/<id>/members.json` in `group.js` and supplies `params[:group_id]` for `params.require(:group_id)` in `Admin::GroupsController#add_members/#remove_member`.
